review.summary: The agent sent 150 dUSD to a never-before-paid address 60 seconds after its own FAIL disclosure and 12 seconds after drawing the same amount. Keep frozen and rotate/revoke the agent key before considering any resume.
review.what_happened: The agent drew 150 dUSD at 12:05:00 and then spent exactly 150 dUSD at 12:05:12 to 0x3128ed42c0c1f27635048412c6cce330d6191632, an address it had never paid before. At 12:04:12 it had emitted its own FAIL disclosure under warrant v11, which required recipientMustBeSelf=1 and disallowed new approvals. The watcher froze it 12 seconds after the trade for TradedAfterFail. This is consistent with compromised key or bypassed tooling rather than a normal repeat venue payment.
evidence: freeze.reason is TradedAfterFail and freeze.seconds_after_trade is 12
disclosures_since_last_unfreeze contains only one FAIL at 2026-11-14T12:04:12Z, warrant_version 11, via agent-sent
draw_before_trade is 150.0 dUSD at 2026-11-14T12:05:00Z, 12 seconds before the trade
warrant_at_trade version 11 has recipientMustBeSelf=1, allowNewApproval=0, maxUsdPerTrade=500.0
history shows 5 disclosures total: 2 PASS and 3 FAIL; 5 prior freezes and 5 prior unfreezes; 8 draws
before_unfreezing: Keep the agent frozen while investigating.
Rotate or revoke the agent key and any credentials that could authorize draws or trades.
Verify whether 0x3128ed42c0c1f27635048412c6cce330d6191632 is an intended recipient; if not, treat the payment as unauthorized.
Inspect the FAIL disclosure, its quote_hash, and the trade calldata to confirm exactly why preflight failed and why the agent proceeded anyway.
Review who initiated the 150 dUSD draw and whether it matches the trade authorization.
Only after remediation, restore mandatory PASS/WARN preflight and resume with a lower budget and stricter recipient allowlisting.
not_shown_by_the_evidence: Whether the agent key was actually compromised or the trade was caused by a tooling/prompt bug
Whether 0x3128ed42c0c1f27635048412c6cce330d6191632 belongs to the agent, owner, an exchange, or an attacker
The agent wallet address or whether recipientMustBeSelf was violated in fact
The details of the FAIL disclosure beyond its verdict and quote_hash
What the other trade since last unfreeze was
Who initiated the draw and whether it was owner-authorized
Whether the trade succeeded or funds remain recoverable
